purpose: Pin the independent legacy source authority used to qualify the restricted dynamic top-boundary component without making the candidate implementation its own oracle.
oracle_rule: The executable oracle independently re-expresses the restricted BoundTop/PondRunoff algebra from the pinned legacy source while reusing only already-qualified lower-level constitutive and restricted surface-evaporation primitives. It must not call evaluate_b110_dynamic_top_boundary internally.

restricted_legacy_mapping.ksat_extension: disabled; saturated surface conductivity is the admitted default-MvG Ksat

legacy_equations_pinned: pondm1>1e-10 => reva=0 and epd=epond; otherwise reva=min(peva,max(0,Emax)) and epd=0 in the admitted swredu=0 profile
q0 = precipitation + irrigation + snowmelt + runon - reva - epd
q1>=0 and q1>Emax => atmospheric prescribed-head regime
h0 = h_top - disnod_top*(q1/k1max + 1); h0<=1e-6 => flux regime
otherwise prescribed-head ponding with h0max = (pondm1 + q0*dt - k1max*dt + p1*h_top)/(p1+1)
h0max<=pondmx => no runoff; otherwise use legacy trial-local runoff test and the analytic linear-runoff update when active runoff is non-negligible
hard_nonclaims: No nonlinear runoff exponent is qualified.
No macropore, frost, Ksat-extension, swdra=2 or time-dependent pondmx behavior is qualified.
This oracle does not by itself qualify HeadCalc replacement, transaction composition or accepted-state publication.
Lower-level default-MvG conductivity and restricted surface-evaporation capabilities remain their own upstream authorities.
